description: List learning sessions on a given conference day (YYYY-MM-DD, conference-local), ordered by start time, with room, track and format.

configuration.query: FROM conference_sessions | WHERE day == ?day AND is_content == true | KEEP title, starts_at_local, room_name, track, format, audience_level | SORT starts_at_local | LIMIT ?limit

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return (e.g. 50)
